pre_declared_criterion.comparison: params_exp0055_race (threats+race) vs params_exp0053_threats (threats only) -- isolates the race INCREMENT
pre_declared_criterion.rationale: Same criterion as exp-0052/0053. Pruning margins are cp-calibrated (futility 110, rev-futility 85, delta 200); exp-0049 at RMS 111.83 cp lost ~160 Elo.
pre_declared_criterion.rule_if_failed: Tighten the IMPLEMENTATION (cap/weights). Never relax this criterion after seeing the distribution.

selection_rationale: ZERO exp-0055 games existed when the scale was chosen, so this is a-priori design, not a post-hoc strength sweep.
eg=1 gave overall RMS 7.14 -- HALF of exp-0052's 13.87, which was INCONCLUSIVE at 3200 games. Repeating that magnitude would likely be unresolvable.
eg=2 gives overall RMS 14.28, close to the CONFIRMED threat term's 16.88 which produced +23.5 Elo.
Both corpora remain inside the pre-declared envelope (RMS<40, p99<=120): overall 14.28/58, endgame 35.66/106.
Far below the destructive magnitudes already measured (exp-0049 RMS 111.83 -> -160 Elo).
note: Scale is FROZEN. A CLOSE or INCONCLUSIVE result does not license rescaling and re-running.
